title.tr: Kalın tahtalı büyük masa ve arkasında bank
title.en: Large thick-board table with a bench behind

alt.tr: Beyaz duvarlı odada kalın tahtalardan yapılmış büyük ahşap masa, arkada bank
alt.en: Large timber table made of thick boards in a white-walled room, with a bench behind

caption.tr: Tabla kalın tahtalardan, ayaklar kalın ve kare kesitli. Arkada çıtalı bir bank var.
caption.en: The top is made of thick boards and the legs are thick and square. A slatted bench stands behind.
